description: Invoke a user-selected maintenance command through the system shell.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary system maintenance automation software, not an evolutionary algorithm. The source performs system maintenance automation only; no candidate population, candidate fitness pipeline, or offspring/replacement lifecycle exists. External processes are started without adequate input or resource controls. Policy basis: This capability is a signal, but the default decision engine needs an optional ExternalAccessPolicy to adjudicate it; without that policy the expected verdict is UNKNOWN.
